findings.desc: doc-internal-contradiction: execution-plan §1 uses the phrase "mutually-distrusting vendor hosts" (line 37) — the exact framing the threat-model §3 explicitly marks as FORBIDDEN for any description of the independence claim (forbidden = "mutually-distrusting parties" / "no operator trust required"). The threat-model correctly caps the claim at cross-vendor-independent, same-operator-orchestrated, not a mutually-hostile trust boundary. The execution-plan §1 is the narrative that sets reader expectations before M1-M5; leaving the forbidden phrase there means the independence over-claim lives precisely where it shapes go/no-go decisions on M4 and M5.
